scope: Generic admission ceilings only. A separately authorized profile still chooses exact scratch/result bytes and template SHA-256. No 4GiB default selection or authority is implied.
role_rules: Only scratch and result may use fresh blank templates. Unknown/system/workload/private roles refuse before file access; private input keeps its separate existing admission.
unchanged_result_contract: Result finalization, envelope schemas, result checker cap, private input presence-only/no-commitment behavior and public workload bound remain unchanged.
source_lineage: SOURCE-IMPORT.json and QUALIFIED-INPUTS.json retain original app3/native provenance. SOURCE-DERIVATION.json binds exact changed/new source and selected native source inventory; the independent expected derivation digest is mandatory for building.
new_identity_required: New native build record/archive, unsigned app, independent review, signing/CDHash and enrollment are required. Historical signed app evidence does not qualify these new ceilings.
qualification: Source candidate only; native build, actual Mini 4GiB execution, peak disk/memory and browser security preset qualification pending. Existing Mini Runner VMs remain untouched.
